fact: The report states there is no AI-specific legislation, that Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024 (in force July 2024) gives a right to human oversight of significant automated decisions (art. 31), that the Ethiopian Communications Authority is the designated data regulator, and that it has not yet shown consistent enforcement on generative AI or deepfakes.
title: Navigating the Implications of AI on Digital Democracy in Ethiopia
publisher: CIPESA (State of Internet Freedom in Africa 2025)
